scope.interval_grouping: By endpoint phase; crossing intervals retained and counted separately.
scope.phase_control: Settle and hold have identical arm-specific controls; the phase boundary is not an actuation change.
scope.velocity_integral: Trapezoid over every native50ms interval, including the midpoint for100ms.
scope.reference: Actor API world vectors reflected CARLA y-right to ROS y-left; virtual-base velocity retains legacy planar transform.
scope.interpretation: Descriptive stationary observations, not a universal noise bound or an explanation of moving-coast failures.
